definitions: In Hindu mythology, Shani is one of the Navagraha (the nine primary celestial beings in Hindu astrology) and is the god of the planet Saturn.
A feminine given name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'my gift' or 'scarlet'.
examples: Shani is often depicted riding a black crow.
Shani's birthday is celebrated with great enthusiasm.
Shani wore a beautiful red dress to the party.
